scope: Read-only Python LangGraph liveness check over every current URL selected from the canonical SQLite store at invocation time
exit_code_reason: The command returns 1 when any URL is expired or uncertain; there were 28 uncertain URLs and no confirmed expired URLs.
first_attempt: The sandboxed Chromium process was denied macOS Mach port registration before any observations were produced. The complete run was repeated in the permitted local environment.
acceptance_limit: The 28 uncertain pages remain unconfirmed and must not be treated as expired. This is a read-only current-URL snapshot, not continuous liveness monitoring or a business-state update.
